title: synthLlama
summary: A Streamlit-based web application for generating single-table, relational, and time-series synthetic data with quality validation. It wraps SDV's synthesizers directly, calling GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, HMASynthesizer, PARSynthesizer, and Metadata from the sdv package to train models and generate data.
